summary: Greenbriar Sustainable Living Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the closing of a non-brokered private placement of 500,000 units at CAD$0.45 per unit for gross proceeds of CAD$225,000. Each unit consists of one common share and one warrant exercisable at CAD$0.55 per share until May 15, 2029. No commissions or finder fees were paid. Proceeds will be used for general working capital. The securities are subject to a four-month hold period expiring September 16, 2026, pending final TSX Venture Exchange approval. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation.
